name: release-desk-jenkins
title: The release desk, and Jenkins, for real
html:
The release desk, and Jenkins, for real

Every party is a HEART service, read and acted on by the same client. Jenkins sits behind a thin HEART wrapper and answers back through RISE.
say: The release desk is a HEART service: a person, or ARTIE, asks it to release a pull request, and it runs the kept script. Its own text/html is shown here, after five releases on the GitHub test repository, run today. Jenkins is real, the official image, in a container on this Mac, building each merged commit and answering back through RISE when the build finishes.
